from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ProfitRecord(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company issuing the report")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The financial period covered, e.g., '2024 年第一季度'")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The label of the profit metric as written in the document, e.g., '利润总额'")
    amount_value: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the profit amount")
    amount_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit or scale of the amount, e.g., '元', '百万元'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    profit_records: list[ProfitRecord]
